page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d3s.2xlarge is a storage-focused virtual machine instance configured with 8 dedicated vCPUs and 32.0 GB of system memory. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz on the x86_64 architecture, this instance runs on the KVM hypervisor. The hardware profile provides a balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio of 4.0 GB per core, paired with a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

The defining characteristic of this instance is its massive local storage capacity, featuring 47,674 GB of bundled HDD storage. This massive storage density makes it highly cost-efficient for workloads requiring large-scale data retention without the premium cost of solid-state drives. However, because the storage relies on HDD technology, sequential and random I/O performance will be lower compared to NVMe-based alternatives, representing a clear trade-off between raw capacity and access speed.

Given its hardware configuration, the ecs.d3s.2xlarge is designed for storage-intensive workloads that do not require high-speed random I/O. Suitable use cases include large-scale data warehousing, distributed file systems, cold data archiving, log processing, and big data analytics frameworks such as MapReduce or Hadoop where sequential disk throughput and high capacity are prioritized over low-latency storage access.
